verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework that also offers Mastra Cloud and stores threads, traces, and datasets, so data export is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence pack documents no export function, bulk-export format, or offboarding path. Being able to run locally or deploy to Vercel, Netlify, or Cloudflare is deployment portability, not data export, and the community comments about lock-in are opinions rather than evidence of an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
